parameters.name: LogCode
parameters.description: The code of the log within the cloud service. For example, the process log of Security Center. For valid values, see the return value of the ListDelivery operation.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The code of the cloud service. Valid values:

- qcloud\_waf

- qlcoud\_cfw

- hcloud\_waf

- hcloud\_cfw

- ddos

- sas

- cfw

- config

- csk

- fc

- rds

- nas

- apigateway

- cdn

- mongodb

- eip

- slb

- vpc

- actiontrail

- waf

- bastionhost

- oss

- polardb

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the data management center of threat analysis is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Select this region if your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- ap-southeast-1: Select this region if your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of a member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of the member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts in your enterprise.
